description: Defines a composable function 'useNavigation' for managing navigation menus in a Vue 3 application, including main navigation, bottom navigation, and user-specific navigation, with plugin integration.

methods.name: useNavigation
methods.description: Main function that provides navigation menu configurations for the app.

methods.name: getNavigationDrawer
methods.description: Generates the main navigation drawer entries, including plugin entries.

methods.name: getBottomNavigation
methods.description: Generates the bottom navigation menu entries, including plugin entries.

methods.name: getUserNavigation
methods.description: Generates user-specific navigation entries, including admin and space switching options.
